verdict.rationale: The models page documents `GET /v1/models`, which returns the model names an account can use, each with a description and release date. It includes cURL, Python and JavaScript examples and a documented response schema. Both SDKs expose list-models methods, so an agent can enumerate the live catalog programmatically, and the versioning docs explain how aliases resolve to versioned IDs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint works as documented, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for it (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).
